name: solera
description: Solera — a slim harness that plans work into a tree of WorkItems (initiative / epic / story / action), runs deterministic gates on the leaves, and orders the steps an external AI agent executes. It supervises rather than builds, and works standalone over a plain-file .noory/solera/ workspace, with or without Plot. Ships skills (plan / run / decide / retro / feedback) and SessionStart/Stop hooks over a `solera` CLI.
